benchmark_scope_rule: All accepted UC1 documents are included in benchmark retrieval. The corpus combines canonical documents resolving the OptFor-EU Policy Map with additional authoritative forest-policy documents that satisfied the predefined UC1 inclusion criteria.
notes: The 19 Policy Map core documents provide an externally defined canonical policy source set.
The 11 additional authoritative documents were collected and accepted under the UC1 inclusion criteria before benchmark execution and are also retrieval-active.
DOC011 remains excluded under the documented review decision.
PM017 COST Actions remains excluded before intake because it does not resolve to one stable policy document.
No document may be added or removed based on benchmark performance.
The corpus remains working until real-document ingestion and provenance validation are complete.
